# Braids By Mimi

> Hair braiding studio in Cheverly / Landover, Maryland (Prince George's County, DC area). Knotless, boho, Fulani, twists, stitch cornrows, soft locs, sew-ins and kids' styles by Mimi. Hair included on most styles. Walk-ins welcome. $25 deposit holds an appointment. English and French spoken.

## Contact and location
- Address: 6492 Landover Rd, Suite B, Room 6, Landover Professional Building, Cheverly, MD 20785
- Phone / text: (469) 441-9208 (booking is by text, call or Instagram DM; no app needed)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/braid_by_mimi/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61550988362454
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 7 AM to 7 PM; Sunday 7 AM to 6 PM. Walk-ins welcome.
- Deposit: $25 holds an appointment.
- Google rating: 5.0
